record_scope_reconstruction: French compelling-reason admission rule for UK arrivals is an all-mode policy. The Folkestone passenger shuttle terminal provides a partial reference for the Channel Tunnel vehicle-passenger rail component, without implying the physical tunnel closed.

source_checks.finding: Official announcement restores compelling reasons for travel to/from UK from Saturday00:00, bars tourism/business, retains citizen/family and compelling-reason categories; tests and isolation separately apply.
Operator explicitly publishes passenger terminal GPS coordinates and motorway approach; freight terminal distinguished.

sites.name: Channel Tunnel — Folkestone passenger terminal
sites.coordinate_method: Published GPS position from the passenger shuttle operator, longitude/latitude order
sites.precision: Operator navigation point for passenger terminal approach; not historical inspection booth or tunnel alignment.
sites.evidence_note: Operator identifies M20 junction 11A passenger check-in access and distinguishes freight/service roads. Vehicle shuttle rail terminal; not Dover ferry or Eurostar station.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: French compelling-reason requirement for vaccinated arrivals from the UK, including the Channel Tunnel land component

date_scope_check.assessment: Dates, movement exceptions, endpoint qualification and >24-hour status remain as recorded; geographic reference does not independently establish uninterrupted closure or extend last-confirmed observations.

unresolved: All-mode policy is wider than one shuttle terminal; Eurostar, ferry and aviation locations not mapped. Terminal location does not independently prove historical enforcement or exact passenger lane.
